name: Notion AI
verdict: The agent now comes with Notion Business at $20 a seat; Free and Plus only include an AI trial.
pros: Agent, meeting notes, and search live where the docs are
Business is a normal seat price, not a separate AI add-on
cons: You pay for the whole workspace, not AI alone
Custom agents need extra credits after the trial
pricingNote: The pricing page lists these as monthly per-member prices. It mentions annual billing but does not show a separate annual rate.
